annotations.title: Order printed certificates on Zazzle, once voting has closed

description: Order printed certificates on Zazzle, once voting has closed Changes nothing. Contests, quizzes and hunts, after voting closes (409 not_closed before). Send each certificate's words as printed, in the contest's language: take the winners from getDashboard (or getResults), e.g. badge 1st, award the category name (or Winner), to Awarded to, name the entry's name, num Entry #7, detail 42 votes, date today, signer Organizer. Up to 90. orders[i] maps each size (11x85 is letter, 14x11 is large) to a Zazzle link that opens that certificate filled in; give the person the links. It's null when the print font can't draw the award or the name (print that one from the dashboard instead). certificates[i] holds the print images. Needs the organizer key.

accent.description: The color as 6 hex digits, no #

award.description: The award, e.g. Scariest, Winner, Quiz champion

place.description: Under the award for 2nd and 3rd, e.g. 2nd place; else empty

signer.description: Over the signature line, e.g. Organizer

slug.description: The id in the public link, e.g. `scarecrow-contest-2026-ab12` from https://qrvote.org/c/scarecrow-contest-2026-ab12
